notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of Outbreak: Shades of Horror can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

Cypress Reel


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

Story mode


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

Invasion mode


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

Raid mode


This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of Outbreak: Shades of Horror, Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

Mini-games


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when Outbreak: Shades of Horror begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

notes.title: Visual Novel 'What Lydia Knows' Launches FRIDAY May 3rd!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/3a0206c53c19290a6b1538592fe9d1c561111128.png

Hello Survivors!

Get ready for a double-dose of adventure this Friday, May 3rd, when Outbreak The FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows launches on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Epic Games Store!

Enjoy a 25% off launch discount here on Steam!

This two game pack includes the following:

FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows

In our first file of “The FEDORA Files” three part limited series: What Lydia Knows, play as intrepid detective Lydia Daniels as she tries to discover the mystery behind her partner's disappearance. Search for clues, probe allies and enemies, and solve the mystery of the Jackson Street Sewers in this installment that acts a prequel to Outbreak: Shades of Horror.

Features:

Narrative rich visual novel with a deep and engrossing storyline.
Multiple paths and endings to unlock where your choices matter.
Meet, befriend, or alienate a wide cast of characters where your relationships matter.
Solve devious puzzles and navigate crazy minigames as you hunt for the truth.


Outbreak RPG

In the aftermath of the Outbreak, play a group of survivors out to rescue their compatriots in Outbreak RPG! A Semi procedurally generated rogue-like RPG, every boot up is a new adventure. Rescued survivors will bring new skills and challenges with them. Can you survive the Outbreak?!

Features:

Semi procedurally generated rogue-like RPG
Lead your party of four survivors through the apocalypse in turn-based combat
Search for supplies to keep yourself armed and healthy
Rescue a wide group of survivors, each of which joins your team with unique upgrades and abilities
Challenging escalating enemy encounters as the city becomes further overrun with the undead
Hilarious and ridiculous dialogue in this non-canon adventure

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

Patch 3
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

Patch 2
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

notes.title: Railbreak is available NOW! Launch stream NOW with giveaways!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

https://youtu.be/y-WS-KRfjDM

Today's the day!  Railbreak is now available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store!  Pick it up for $19.99 USD worldwide (international pricing may vary).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587170/Railbreak/

While Cypress Ridge is enduring a zombie apocalypse in Outbreak: Shades of Horror, Lydia and Hank hit the arcade for some stress relief!  Railbreak is packed with features and content that will keep you playing! It's a beefy on-rails arcade shooter for the modern age, and it's built in Unreal Engine 5!

Players can look forward to:

A fully voiced, cheese-tastic Story!
Score Attack for grinding those high scores!
The endless Onslaught mode that'll test your skills!
'Glitch' modifiers that keep the gameplay fast and feisty!
Eight total unlockable characters, each with their own loadouts and stats!
Seven radical bosses that are out for blood!
A special scenario that celebrates our supporters -- Shoutout Shootout!
Glitch Gauntlet, A rogue-like version of the campaign with randomized 'Glitches' and enemies!
The mother of all challenges in Boss Rush!
Full game, optional co-op support so you can spread the lead with a friend!
Optional support for Sinden Lightguns on PC platforms!
Local score tracking, a comprehensive How to Play manual, and tons of settings and options!


Please note: If you are playing on Xbox Series X|S, there is a 'day one' update that is not yet live. This will be available as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding, and sorry for the inconvenience!

We've also prepared a series of guides for those of you who are purchasing the Steam version of the game in order to best enjoy it in a variety of configurations:

Railbreak Sinden Lightgun Guide - Setup instructions for using a Sinden Lightgun with Railbreak!

Recommended Steam Deck Settings - How to best configure Railbreak for use on Steam Deck!

Controls and Remote Play Together Guide - See default controls and other tips for multiplayer!

If you aren't already a part of our Discord community, join today and share your best scores with us!  We're holding a launch contest through January 5th at 11:59pm ET with a special prize, so come and compete with the best for your chance to win!

Meanwhile, tonight, December 22nd, at 7PM ET (that's right now!), we're having a special launch stream on our Twitch channel!  For the first time, we'll also be streaming live to Railbreak's Steam store page!  Join us for Railbreak gameplay featuring the Sinden Lightgun, retro on-rail shooter game goodness, and giveaways

Our games are also on sale as part of Steam's Winter Sale, and that includes the Outbreak Complete Collection, which also includes Railbreak! Save on a ton of great Dead Drop Studios games today with this special bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20872/Outbreak_Complete_Collection

With that, we're entering a Holiday break period.  On behalf of everyone at Dead Drop Studios, we would like to wish you and your families a very Merry Christmas, an incredibly Happy Holiday, and a fantastic New Year!

See you in 2024, Survivors!

notes.title: Outbreak: Endless Nightmares Releases on May 19th, 2021!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33023292/6c107c67eb2e503bc66f58e9512599686b2c8fb8.jpg
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419350/Outbreak_Endless_Nightmares/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HOKiSeM7hm8
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-GameDescription-600.jpg?t=1618691544
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-steamgif-OTS-02.gif?t=1618691544
Outbreak: Endless Nightmares twists the series' survival horror gameplay by adding elements of roguelike gameplay. You'll need to explore, hunt for supplies, uncover clues, and fight your way through each anomaly – each consisting of semi-procedurally generated instances where both the environment, and the undead, are out to kill you!

Immediately after the events of Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles, you find yourself trapped within the remains of Arzt Memorial Hospital – the hub to organize your inventory and storage cache, level up your character, or just to take a breather before venturing back out into the chaos. There’s more to discover in the world besides murderous hordes of the undead – find the journals scattered about to learn more about the outbreak and ultimately where to find refuge! Don’t think death can save you – every time you die, you'll awake trapped in this nexus.

Outbreak: Endless Nightmares focuses on extreme replayability by offering multiple character options – each with their own abilities, upgrade paths and more! Each time you venture into the anomaly, it’ll change and become increasingly difficult as you grow in power. You'll need to think carefully about what weapons, healing items, and other supplies you'll bring along. If you're lucky, you may find storage caches that give you access to your expanded inventory, and offer an opportunity to restock. But it's all on you to search your environment for supplies. If you run out ... your fate is sealed!
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-KeyFeatures-600.jpg?t=1618691544
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-steamgif-tactical-01.gif?t=1618691544

Something Old, Something New: Outbreak’s signature classic survival gameplay mixed with roguelike elements.
An Expanding World: Explore a massive, semi-procedurally generated world that expands as the game progresses! Talk to NPCs, visit shops, etc.
Three Camera Angles: Choose a view that works for you – Fixed camera, over the shoulder, or first person. 
Photo Mode: Take beautiful pictures with the camera or use the photo mode to scan or anything dangerous nearby!
Death Isn’t the End: Death returns you to the hub with most of your inventory intact, experience, and money.
Semi-Procedurally Generated Dungeons: Revisit anomaly dungeons multiple times to find different traps, enemies, puzzles, challenges – and loot! 
Co-Op: Fight the nightmare with a friend in 2-player Split-Screen Co-Op.
Character Options: Choose from 6 unique characters, each with their own backstory, stats, and ability loadouts.
Crafting: Dismantle, repair, and upgrade weapons; build ammo through gunpowder; and combine healing items to create new formulas and more!
Game Modes: Choose from 5 gameplay modes – Standard, Ironman, Randomizer, Lost Hope, and Easy Mode.
Uncover the Story: Search through notes and logs to read more from Lydia’s journal and piece together the past and future of the outbreak.
Late Game Content / New Game+: Face a randomly generated dungeon of extreme danger near the end of the game AND try multiple new game + modes after completing the story.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-steamgif-fixed-03.gif?t=1618691544

Grab the Nightmare Edition to get the entire Outbreak: Lost Hope experience PLUS Outbreak: The New Nightmare at an amazing price! Experience the best single-player and multiplayer Outbreak has to offer with the Nightmare Edition!

Outbreak: Lost Hope
Outbreak: Lost Hope Deluxe Edition

About Outbreak: Lost Hope
Experience a mother's desperate search for her daughter in the midst of a nation-wide epidemic. Taking place in the Outbreak universe by Dead Drop Studios, this story follows Gwen just after her harrowing escape from an urban center during the outbreak. A terrible accident causes her to get separated from her daughter Hope and she has to fight the undead to survive... and save her daughter.

notes.title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles Chapter Two - Releasing June 18th, 2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/ef7d3f1add75493e9023c4a4b4d1591c7640b6ff.jpg
Return to the world of survival horror on the evening of June 18th, 2018.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/74b79c4e75f155be7054ddb3a26abf983e629f94.jpg
Chapter Two
Lydia's fight for survival continues as she explores the tunnels underneath the manor. When you last left her, she had barely survived her encounter with a brute, was out of ammo and was desperate for safety. Your adventure picks up in the tunnels beneath as she faces new challenges, including pitch darkness. Featuring new Story Mode and Battle Mode chapters taking place in the tunnels. Can you survive the nightmare?
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/1aa34973ba50c3202190a52d41230a2536fe9422.jpg
Patch v1.2
When Chapter Two releases, the next patch will be included. This patch includes enemy combat adjustments that give you more of a chance to dodge incoming attacks. It also includes graphics upgrades like volumetric lighting for Lydia's flashlights. There is also some minor difficulty and content adjustments and general bugfixes.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/c564e09331428c8b3b396cf7291eed1b315b0fb1.jpg

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 6/3/2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/74b79c4e75f155be7054ddb3a26abf983e629f94.jpg
Bi-weekly is a type of weekly...

Chapter Two Progress Update
The last week included finishing the first drafts of both Story Mode and Battle Mode content for Chapter Two, including a bunch of fixes under the hood for the game. I would say at the time of this writing, Chapter Two is maybe around 75% complete and I feel like I'm on track for a Summer 2018 release on Steam (Xbox One will be later).
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/de77f67003a38089a137b947abe53b328d0c3d55.jpg
It's been a fun scenario to create given the focus on pitch darkness. The volumetric light from Lydia's flashlights really adds some dimension to the darkness and I think you'll enjoy watching the shadows bounce across the walls.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/5788bf8d3cfaed2adb6b4e9ceff67bac8fab7055.jpg
Chapter Two is also going to stress out you in some new ways. Many items that were "freebies" in Chapter One, like storage boxes, power weapons, etc... a bit more... secured in Chapter Two. You'll need to solve puzzles to unlock them, and let's just say it may not be possible to open everything up in your playthrough. You'll need to choose between opening up a new storage chest location and potentially opening a gun case for example.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/7189649a66974987effda00220ad623457e8fed4.jpg
My focus in the next few weeks is adding in all of the story lore, environment inspectables and polishing up the experience (including difficulty balancing). Stay tuned though, because I don't think your time surviving the darkness is too far off. ;) Thanks again for supporting the game and be sure to keep sharing news about it with friends!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 5/20/2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/c564e09331428c8b3b396cf7291eed1b315b0fb1.jpg
I never said which week...

Chapter Two Progress Update
The layout for the Chapter Two map is virtually complete, but there's no actual game logic or events in yet. Get ready for a descent into darkness though as Lydia tries to escape the underground, while battling out-of-control gas mains spewing fire. The darkness is going to provide cover for the undead as well... and they can come from anywhere. In the coming weeks, I'll be working to add notes, interests and all of the other gameplay events that make an Outbreak scenario fun.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/65abd1bd1c6c3f1024c6ca935a3360491f744335.jpg
Combat Fixes
Chapter Two will also debut with some improvements to how enemies attack you. Right now, it's very difficult to juke an enemy and run past them without taking damage. There will be improvements that will allow enemies to only hit you when they're at a certain point in their animation swing. This has been one of the most requested features and it should greatly improve gameplay.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/dfd2d91bdbb0e06af90bd0f8feda834f69e18150.jpg
So when will it be out?
I'm still not ready to commit to a release date, but the goal is for Chapter Two to debut during summer. There's still a lot more that needs to go into it before it's ready. As always, it'll likely appear on Steam before Xbox One.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/52ccad51b1dcbb9455d4d9fe4d94979a69d8deec.jpg
Thank you!
As always, thank you to the entire community for playing ALL of the Outbreak games! It's been great to see more and more folks trying the games and the good reviews pouring in. Keep sharing them with your friends and your support is super appreciated and critical to the franchise continuing. Thank you!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/1aa34973ba50c3202190a52d41230a2536fe9422.jpg

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 5/5/2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/315f6f2d6fc450471251924e891df84e9cb34883.jpg
The irony of calling these updates "Weekly" is not lost on me...

You never write... You never call...
It has been an absolute whirlwind the last two months. Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles has now launched on both Steam and Xbox One (to pretty good reviews I'd say!). As such, a lot of my time has been spent preparing for those releases, working through cert and handling all of the "non-dev" parts of being an indie developer. I pushed a PC-side Steam patch a few weeks back and all of those fixes made it into the Xbox One version that was released a few days back. But with those releases behind me... it's time to think about the future...
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/10b5e0e4a86b300841730a4ef4c719fda5dc0e30.jpg
Chapter Two
Chapter One saw Lydia's story continue as she survived the events of The New Nightmare and now found herself alone in a manor. Well, spoiler alert, but she survived Chapter One as well. Chapter Two picks up almost immediately after the end of the first chapter, with her exploring even further beneath the manor. She's going to find all new horrors down there and gameplay is taking a bit of a shift... There will be some new locations, but I don't want to spoil them too much in the screenshots here.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/06e90dc82a5af6088266babd76cb3e4bac26e174.jpg
Being Alone in the Dark...
The theme of Chapter Two is going to be darkness. Let's just say near the start of Chapter Two, there's going to be a bit of a power loss in the underground section. As such, Lydia will need to rely on her trusty flashlight to find a way back to the surface alive. Anywhere she isn't looking, will be pitch black. Think of this as a loving homage to Silent Hill...
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/0cf20bf0348781015224788caab26cb4a918d265.jpg
Graphics Improvements
With darkness being so prominent in Chapter Two, it made sense to make some lighting upgrades. Lydia's flashlight and chest light will now have volumetric light beams. This greatly helps in illuminating the darkness, but you'll also notice them subtly added to Chapter One. They're far more prominent in pitch black. You'll face this darkness in the next set of Battle Mode rooms as well...
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/fb310eadb8751df1e1aedc257e52c6be713dc381.jpg
So when is Chapter Two coming out?
It's going to be a while. I'm a solo dev working on the game in my limited free time. I'll try to keep sharing updates and I hope it won't be too long, but let's say we'll aim for sometime during the summer if things go well. I would imagine the Xbox release will trail Steam in general for The Nightmare Chronicles as I can release faster on Steam. Stay tuned for more details.

Thank you to everyone who has purchased and played any games in the Outbreak series! It has been an awesome ride and the feedback and support is amazing. It's awesome to have such a great community and COME JOIN US ON DISCORD!

notes.title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles is now Available on Windows, Linux & OS X!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/78da22f439924f1812bd0ea7c80eb965150577d8.png
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles is now available on Steam (Windows, Linux & OS X)!

Launch Packages and Discounts
During launch week, the base game (including the Season Pass and Complete Editions which offer a built-in discount) will have an additional 10% off. New story and Battle Mode content will be made available during 2018 and 2019! Lock in now at this great price!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/04f700bce710f980698fd96197887d80f5de182e.jpg
About the Game
As the city burns and the countryside is engulfed by the epidemic, the living are increasingly alone and forced to live with this new reality. Monstrous beasts and disfigured remnants roam freely with their numbers increasing rapidly, slaughtering everything in their path. In the opening chapter, Lydia finds herself separated from her fellow survivors and all alone. After fleeing into a large manor estate to escape the relentless horde, her only goal now is survival. She must explore the manor, locate supplies and find a way to wake from this nightmare. But somehow... she knows her fate is already sealed.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/6aaae59668f3df9879c9a539e139fec4e23772d2.jpg
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles is an episodic unforgiving survival horror experience that takes place within the Outbreak universe. Death lurks behind each door as you fight to survive with the limited supplies at your disposal. Search rooms thoroughly and make the right choice when to fight - or flee - from the monstrosities. Featuring classic hardcore survival horror gameplay in a directed single-player experience, you'll need to stay on your toes to stay alive. You have a limited inventory and you'll need to leverage supply caches to store your equipment for use later. Saving your game is also highly restrictive and you'll need to locate the means to record your progress as you explore. Lydia's adventure is just the beginning... can you survive the chronicles and determine the fate of the other survivors?

notes.title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles Announced!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/69579e0d1cb78788079b9c9a4066ba515d55f91f.png
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles, featuring single-player adventures in the Outbreak universe, has been announced!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/09726cd0617b24b17163a42b354885790748cca1.jpg
What is Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles?
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles is a slower-paced single-player survival horror adventure. Whereas Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare focused on high intensity co-op play, The Nightmare Chronicles instead focuses on a slower-paced, highly difficult survival horror experience. Taking place chronologically right after The New Nightmare concluded, The Nightmare Chronicles will follow the cast of survivors as they attempt to survive after being split up.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/4ca80edb55a4b37f7cf428c7ac25cecaf42508d2.jpg
How will the game be structured?
The game will feature episodic-style play focusing on a specific character. The initial chapter, which features Lydia, will take her through an abandoned manor that she sought safety in after being split up from the group. This initial chapter will be a low-priced offering and subsequent chapters will be offered as paid DLC when they are available. This allows players to only pay for content they want while ensuring the game can be delivered faster in piecemeal form.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/64998c0e1d98df06d45d147a76f175251a09e2fc.jpg
How is this game different than Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare?
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles will focus on exploration and strict inventory management to survive. You will need to thoroughly search your environment to find supplies, solve puzzles and stand a chance against threats. The Nightmare Chronicles also forgoes the full, open maps from the previous games and instead features instanced rooms like in classic survival horror. This allows you to potentially flee a room to escape from a foe and face them later. The Nightmare Chronicles will feature linked storage caches for managing your items and require you to find consumable floppy disks to save your game.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/67f92ce258ecdc5427641b7e242d4dba95dbf093.jpg
What else has changed?
With the gameplay getting mixed up, you'll also find some improvements under the hood. Game performance in The Nightmare Chronicles will be significantly better than in The New Nightmare due to the ability to instance geometry and game logic in individual rooms or location. As such, the recommended and minimum system requirements have dropped significantly.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/897ba0ba7588c5da84b2bfa2ff6dfc43a26bd708.jpg
When will we get to play the first chapter?
There is no announced release date for the first chapter, which likely will be 1-2 hours of gameplay, just yet. Since this game is developed by a solo dev without a budget, these things take time to build and polish. We'll be in touch later on with more information.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/09726cd0617b24b17163a42b354885790748cca1.jpg
What is Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles?
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles is a slower-paced single-player survival horror adventure. Whereas Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare focused on high intensity co-op play, The Nightmare Chronicles instead focuses on a slower-paced, highly difficult survival horror experience. Taking place chronologically right after The New Nightmare concluded, The Nightmare Chronicles will follow the cast of survivors as they attempt to survive after being split up.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/4ca80edb55a4b37f7cf428c7ac25cecaf42508d2.jpg
How will the game be structured?
The game will feature episodic-style play focusing on a specific character. The initial chapter, which features Lydia, will take her through an abandoned manor that she sought safety in after being split up from the group. This initial chapter will be a low-priced offering and subsequent chapters will be offered as paid DLC when they are available. This allows players to only pay for content they want while ensuring the game can be delivered faster in piecemeal form.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/64998c0e1d98df06d45d147a76f175251a09e2fc.jpg
How is this game different than Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare?
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles will focus on exploration and strict inventory management to survive. You will need to thoroughly search your environment to find supplies, solve puzzles and stand a chance against threats. The Nightmare Chronicles also forgoes the full, open maps from the previous games and instead features instanced rooms like in classic survival horror. This allows you to potentially flee a room to escape from a foe and face them later. The Nightmare Chronicles will feature linked storage caches for managing your items and require you to find consumable floppy disks to save your game.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/67f92ce258ecdc5427641b7e242d4dba95dbf093.jpg
What else has changed?
With the gameplay getting mixed up, you'll also find some improvements under the hood. Game performance in The Nightmare Chronicles will be significantly better than in The New Nightmare due to the ability to instance geometry and game logic in individual rooms or location. As such, the recommended and minimum system requirements have dropped significantly.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/897ba0ba7588c5da84b2bfa2ff6dfc43a26bd708.jpg
When will we get to play the first chapter?
There is no announced release date for the first chapter, which likely will be 1-2 hours of gameplay, just yet. Since this game is developed by a solo dev without a budget, these things take time to build and polish. We'll be in touch later on with more information.
